sections.section_title: MCE cipher context z key register 3 (MCE_CCzKEYR3)
sections.text_helper: Section 51.6.18 "MCE cipher context z key register 3 (MCE_CCzKEYR3)" in chapter 51 (Memory cipher engine (MCE)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2448.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x258 + 0x30 * (z - 1) (z =1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Writes are ignored if CCLOCK or KEYLOCK are set in MCE_CCzCFGR register, or GLOCK
bit is set in MCE_CR register.
Bits 31:0 KEY[127:96]: cipher key, bits [127:96]
Refer to the MCE_CCzKEYR0 register for description of the KEY[127:0] bitfield.
